methodology: Codex independently reopened the manager, company, transaction and prospectus sources, visually reviewed the decisive prospectus pages, and searched ACL Airshop and Astatine/Alinda transaction variants for later sales, recapitalizations, mergers, sponsor changes and signed pending transactions through the local as-of date.
identityConclusion: ACL Airshop is one manager-level global air-cargo unit load device leasing and logistics platform headquartered in Greenville, South Carolina. ACL Airshop, LLC is the legal identity; Airline Container Leasing and AirShop Holdings are historical predecessor names, while airport stations, fleets, repair sites, software, products and customers are operations rather than separate PortCos.
ownershipConclusion: Alinda-managed AF4 acquired ACL Airshop in April 2021. Alinda renamed its mid-market infrastructure strategy Astatine Investment Partners in April 2022, so the rename did not create a second owner or a new holding period. A January 2023 prospectus states that AF4 held 100% of ACL Airshop, and Astatine's March 2026 release still calls ACL a portfolio company of Astatine-managed funds.
exitSearchConclusion: No later sale, recapitalization, merger, sponsor change or signed pending ACL Airshop ownership transaction was identified through 2026-08-17. The live Astatine portfolio page marks ACL Active and the March 2026 Astatine release reaffirms current stewardship.
recommendedRecordDisposition: Create one active ACL Airshop company with one active Astatine Investment Partners ownership period linked to Alinda Infrastructure Fund IV from 2021. Do not create separate Alinda, predecessor, airport, fleet, product or customer records.
